title: TE Dae’Quan Wright could be a Day 3 steal for the Broncos

sources.title: TE Dae’Quan Wright could be a Day 3 steal for the Broncos
sources.description: One prospect the Denver Broncos have been showing interest in and could select on day 3 of the 2026 NFL Draft is Ole Miss tight end Dae’Quan Wright. He is a 6-4, 246-pound tight end who is an intriguing pass-catching prospect who can attack defenses vertically. Wright started his career at Virginia and spent two […]
